details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole symposium, emphasizing persistent inflation above the 2% target and suggesting current financial conditions are not restrictive enough. This stance significantly increased market expectations for a September interest rate hike, prompting a risk-off sentiment across financial markets. Consequently, Bitcoin fell from approximately $80,000 to below $77,000, contributing to a broader cryptocurrency market sell-off and significant liquidations of leveraged long positions.
title: Hawkish Fed Speech Drives Bitcoin Below $77K
